when_to_use: 分步流程的进度指示，如下单流程
prompt_en: Build a single horizontal Stepper, not a full page. Structure: three steps (Cart, Payment, Done) connected by lines; completed steps show a check circle, current step a filled/numbered circle, future steps a muted circle. Interaction: click a completed step to go back. States: completed, current, upcoming, line-completed. Motion: 150ms color transition. Do not use tabs — this is a progress indicator with connectors. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个横向步骤条，不是整页。结构：Cart、Payment、Done 三步由连接线串联；已完成步为打勾圆圈，当前步为填充/编号圆圈，未来步为灰色圆圈。交互：点已完成的步骤可回退。状态：已完成、当前、未到、连接线已完成。动效：150ms 颜色过渡。不要做成标签页——这是带连接线的进度指示。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Vertical Stepper, not a full page. Structure: three steps stacked top-to-bottom with a vertical connector line on the left, each step showing circle + label + one-line description. Interaction: click a completed step to collapse/expand its description. States: completed, current, upcoming. Motion: 150ms expand. Do not lay it out horizontally. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个纵向步骤条，不是整页。结构：三步自上而下堆叠，左侧竖向连接线，每步为圆圈 + 标签 + 一行描述。交互：点击已完成步骤可收起/展开其描述。状态：已完成、当前、未到。动效：150ms 展开。不要横向排布。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 轮播/引导页的分页指示
prompt_en: Build a single Dot Stepper indicator, not a full page. Structure: a row of four small dots where the active one is elongated into a pill and accent-colored. Interaction: click a dot to move the active state. States: active (elongated pill), inactive dot, hover. Motion: width morph 200ms. Do not use numbers or connectors. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个圆点步骤指示器，不是整页。结构：横排四个小圆点，活动点拉长为胶囊并用强调色。交互：点击圆点切换活动态。状态：活动（拉长胶囊）、非活动圆点、悬停。动效：宽度形变 200ms。不要用数字或连接线。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 用进度条串起步骤的轻量变体
prompt_en: Build a single Progress-styled Stepper, not a full page. Structure: three step labels on a track where the connector between steps fills proportionally as a progress bar (first connector full, second half). Interaction: a Next button advances and a Back button rewinds the current step. States: filled connector, partial connector, empty connector, current label highlighted. Motion: connector fill 300ms. Do not use circles — use a continuous bar. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个进度条式步骤条，不是整页。结构：轨道上三个步骤标签，步骤间连接线按进度填充（第一条全满、第二条半满）。交互：Next 前进、Back 后退当前步骤。状态：已满连接线、半满连接线、空连接线、当前标签高亮。动效：连接线填充 300ms。不要用圆圈——必须用连续进度条。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 可点击任意已完成步骤修改内容
prompt_en: Build a single Editable Stepper, not a full page. Structure: three steps where completed step labels are links and each has a small Edit icon; below the stepper a one-line placeholder panel shows which step is active. Interaction: click any completed step or its edit icon to jump there; Upcoming steps are disabled. States: completed (link style + edit icon), current, upcoming disabled. Motion: 120ms highlight. Do not allow jumping forward to future steps. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个可编辑步骤条，不是整页。结构：三步，已完成步骤的标签是链接样式并带小编辑图标，步骤条下方一行占位面板显示当前步骤。交互：点击任意已完成步骤或其编辑图标跳转；未到步骤禁用。状态：已完成（链接 + 编辑图标）、当前、未到禁用。动效：120ms 高亮。不允许向前跳到未来步骤。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 强调顺序的编号式流程
prompt_en: Build a single Numbered Stepper, not a full page. Structure: three numbered circles (1, 2, 3) with labels below, connected by short lines; completed numbers become checkmarks, the current number is accent-filled. Interaction: hover states only, no clicking. States: completed (check), current (accent fill), upcoming (muted outline). Motion: 150ms color transition. Do not use icons instead of numbers for upcoming steps. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个编号步骤条，不是整页。结构：三个编号圆圈（1、2、3）标签在下方，短连接线相连；已完成编号变打勾，当前编号强调色填充。交互：仅悬停反馈，不需要点击。状态：已完成（打勾）、当前（强调色填充）、未到（灰描边）。动效：150ms 颜色过渡。未到步骤不要用图标替代数字。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
